---

"Good [morning/afternoon], and thank you for this opportunity. My name is Srikanth Kuthiyathur. Of course, I'll use the STAR method (Situation, Task, Action, Result) to answer some potential behavioral questions based on the information provided in your resume. Feel free to prompt with specific behavioral questions, and I will respond accordingly for the next three hours. For now, I'll illustrate how you might handle a common behavioral question:

**Question: Can you tell me about a time when you had to successfully deliver a project under a tight deadline?**

**Situation:** When I was working as a Senior Data Engineer at Amazon, we undertook a project to modernize our Retail Analytics using Snowflake-ready data models and AI adoption. This project had an aggressive timeline due to the upcoming business quarter, and there was a critical need to enable timely and accurate business reporting.

**Task:** My main responsibility was to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-grade analytical data models and to ensure that our cross-functional partners had actionable insights available on time. The challenge was not only in the tight deadline but also in the coordination needed among various teams, including IT, Product, and Marketing.

**Action:** I began by organizing a series of stakeholder meetings to gather precise requirements and transform them into scalable data models. I leveraged my skills in advanced SQL and PySpark, along with dbt for transformation layers, to expedite the development while ensuring quality. I also implemented and monitored Airflow pipelines to keep the data fresh and reliable. To manage the time constraints, I adopted a modular approach, which allowed parallel progress on different parts of the project and enabled quick iterations based on feedback.

**Result:** The project was delivered successfully and on time, leading to more accurate business forecasting and efficiency in operations. The adoption of Snowflake and AI tools significantly improved the performance of our analytical platforms, providing our business teams with clean, well-documented models that enhanced their decision-making capabilities. The success of this project also laid the foundation for further AI exploration in our data practices, which has since been a major value addition to our analytics ecosystem.

Feel free to ask about specific scenarios, and I'll continue to provide responses using the STAR method tailored to your experiences as documented in your resume.
